payload.title: Unusual cost is flagged from the agent's own history
payload.description:
Ryan's ruling: an unusually costly Story flags a person and never stops. 'Unusual' is learned: a run or a Story whose cost is far outside the distribution of that agent's own past runs raises one flag with the numbers. Remove the fixed 0.50 dollar guard in `monitoring_stories.py` and make `budgetUsdPerRun` an owner setting that also only flags.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A run far above the agent's history raises one flag and is not stopped.
- No fixed dollar constant remains in agent code.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- unusual-cost.feature: a run within history raises nothing; a far outlier raises one flag with the figures; an agent with little history says so instead of guessing.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** Spend, budgets and model tiers. Slice code G3 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
